title: Geography Atlas — Place, Territory, State, Boundary, Network and Scale
purpose: Give the World layer a neutral geographic grammar so countries, territories, cities, regions, seas, infrastructure corridors, cultural areas and project-symbolic directions are not collapsed into one kind of place.

geographic_objects.definition: A point or geometry in a reference system.
A named location whose meaning may be physical, social, historical or administrative.
A jurisdictional subdivision defined by a governing system.
A political/legal entity with institutions and territorial claims/status.
geographic_objects.boundary: Statehood, recognition, sovereignty and territorial control are related but not identical fields.

geographic_objects.definition: A bounded or claimed geographic area whose governing/sovereignty status must be represented explicitly.
A spatially distributed cultural/historical field that may cross state borders.
geographic_objects.boundary: Cultural regions are not automatically political claims.

geographic_objects.definition: An area defined by flows or systems rather than identity alone.
A route or chain connecting places through transport, energy, trade, migration, communication or strategic function.
A distributed spatial system where topology of connections matters as much as contiguous territory.

boundary_model.rule: A map line must not silently merge legal boundary, claimed boundary, administrative boundary, ceasefire line, cultural area and project-symbolic region.

place_identity_model.temporal_rule: Names, borders, jurisdictions and status can change; place identity must be time-aware.

country_room_model.caution: Country relations can describe interdependence without implying alliance, hostility, hierarchy or motive.

map_geometry_types.use: A specific geocodable origin, headquarters, site or event location.
A bounded or approximate regional origin where a point would falsely imply precision.
A corridor, journey, migration or infrastructure chain.
A formation whose meaningful geography is multiple linked nodes.
A primarily digital origin or operating space with no singular physical point.
Location evidence is insufficient or contradictory.

symbolic_firewall.rule: North, West, East, South, Heaven, Swamp, Garden or other project directions may be overlays but do not replace ordinary coordinates, legal geography or political status.
symbolic_firewall.implementation: Store project-symbolic orientation as a separate relation/layer referencing the ordinary geographic object.
